description: Angular component for managing and displaying a relation table in the Thingsboard UI, including relation CRUD operations, filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: RelationTableComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing entity relations with filtering, sorting, pagination, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes resize observer for responsive layout adjustments.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and subscriptions.

methods.name: updateColumns
methods.description: Sets displayed columns based on relation direction.

methods.name: directionChanged
methods.description: Handles change in relation search direction and updates columns and data.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up reactive streams for search, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Loads relation data based on current filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enables text search filter mode and focuses input.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Disables text search filter mode and resets search input.

methods.name: resetSortAndFilter
methods.description: Resets sorting and filtering to default state.

methods.name: addRelation
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new relation.

methods.name: editRelation
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing relation.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a specific relation after confirmation.

methods.name: openRelationDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for adding or editing a relation.
